title: Check trust-list integrity
description: Engineering consequence of GDHCN Trustlists (DID), Example DID documents; HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management.

statements.label: Check trust-list integrity
statements.requirement: The DID trustlist client SHOULD verify the JWS proof on fetched DID documents against a configured GDHCN anchor, and SHALL use HTTPS with platform certificate validation.
